legacy_cells.B: A Triple-Tier Secure Mobile-Cloud Framework Integrating AES–DES Hybrid Cryptosystem and Blockchain for COVID-Related Cardiovascular Data Protection
legacy_cells.I: 035_2026_A Triple-Tier Secure Mobile-Cloud Framework Integrating AES–DES Hybrid Cryptosystem and Blockchain for COVID-Related Cardiovascular Data Protecti.pdf
legacy_cells.O: COVID-19-related cardiovascular risk and cardiac abnormalities
legacy_cells.S: Do ECG-image-derived features predict COVID-related cardiovascular risk?
legacy_cells.T: COVID-positive ECG samples and ECGs from patients with cardiac diseases in the ECG Images of Cardiac and COVID-19 Patients dataset; cohort size and demographics not reported.
legacy_cells.DN: ECG Images of Cardiac and COVID-19 Patients dataset
legacy_cells.EG: Cloudlet-assisted processing reportedly reduced latency by about 40% versus local processing.
legacy_cells.EN: Reports SHA-3 tamper-detection tests across attack types; reported detection rates exceeded 98.7%.
legacy_cells.EO: Hybrid AES-DES token encryption, SHA-3 integrity fingerprints, permissioned blockchain anchoring, and zero-trust access control.
legacy_cells.FL: ECG images → morphological reconstruction and fractal-guided tokenization → wavelet-entropy/recurrence features → Bayesian cardiovascular-risk score; cryptographic security and cloudlet offloading surround this pipeline. No persistent state, transition model, or planner is described.
legacy_cells.FM: Integrates ECG-image preprocessing and fractal-guided tokenization, three-tier cryptographic/blockchain protection, cloudlet-assisted processing, and Bayesian cardiovascular-risk assessment.
legacy_cells.FN: Bayesian risk prediction: accuracy 97.4% (Table 8); cloudlet offloading: approximately 40% latency improvement; SHA-3 integrity detection rates reported above 98.7% across attack types.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors state the evaluation uses only one publicly available ECG-image dataset, which may not represent the variety of clinical devices and patients; multi-institution implementation may face governance and interoperability challenges.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose multi-centre clinical validation, multimodal physiological data, federated learning, post-quantum cryptography, and pilot/deployment studies.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify fragmented solutions: security-oriented systems may be analytically weak, while intelligent solutions may be vulnerable to security attacks; they motivate an integrated security, processing, and analytics framework.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports ECG-image-to-risk prediction and reported security/performance metrics, not a persistent temporal state transition, action-conditioned forecast, multi-step rollout, counterfactual comparison, or planning/control. Claimed real-time clinical suitability is not prospective clinical validation; authors call for multi-centre validation and pilot applications.
legacy_cells.FX: Reviewed the full extracted text: title/abstract and Introduction; Related Work; Methods §§3–3.10 and Algorithm 1; Results, Tables 2–9, Discussion, Limitations, Conclusion/Future Work, declarations, and references. Relevant passages were read across PDF pp. 2–31; front matter and later reference pages were also reviewed. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The PDF text extraction has broken alignment/labels in several tables (notably Tables 3–7 and 9), and equations are missing symbols. Table 8 clearly reports 97.4% accuracy; Table 7 narrative reports about 40% latency improvement. The Methods say the dataset is public and hosted on Mendeley Data, but the Data Availability Statement says the dataset is available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; DP is coded Public open based on the explicit public-dataset description and cited Mendeley dataset. No A:I values were changed. Evidence QA: 28/28 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 28 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All34physical pages and32references read. All17figures/9tables/Algorithm1 and all20equations visually inspected; all pages rendered, no appendix included. Missing text-extracted mathematical symbols resolved by equation-page images.

No train/validation/test split, patient independence, sample selection/event labels/horizon or fitted Bayesian prior/likelihood details. Reported97.4%/CI cannot establish R2 without heldout protocol; no readiness facets assigned.
Table8 recall/sensitivity and precision/PPV differ without averaging definitions. Figure10 confusion matrix/class distribution not explained relative Table8. No calculated corrections.

Confidentiality Index/VeryHigh attack resistance undefined; no cryptographic proof/attacker-budget or hardware/network/timing protocol. Named algorithms and measured-style tables not clinical-grade/secure certification.

Public-source dataset vs reasonable-request availability wording preserved; own code/weights unreported. Ref27 related author2024 framework may share lineage, not independent corroboration. Single-model review, no human independent review/replication.
notes: Security implementation and evaluation claims kept stage-qualified; no crypto-effectiveness or clinical-validity inference. Feature entropy not predictive uncertainty calibration. Blockchain ledger state is not patient world-model state. Article license not code/data/weight terms.
